findings.F1: The tested forecast carries no move: its raw level, in quintiles per coin on the 5-day grid, gives a slope t of -0.17 (n 3420), and its cases' unusual move is -0.05 % (0.002 of a usual 10.60 % move) against a total move of -0.64 %; the book's loss is the coins' drift working against a book that was short on 15 313 of 17 380 coin-bars (mean -0.065 % per bar, 0 on the 2 067 flat bars).
findings.F2: A large daily rise, measured against the coin's 20-day typical daily move, is followed by a rise over the next 5 days that grows with its size: +0.59 % after a rise of 0 to 1 typical move (n 985, t 1.7), +2.14 % after 1 to 2 (n 286, t 3.3), +3.19 % above 2 (n 94, t 2.2), against a normal 5-day drift of about 0.6 %, so an unusual move of about 1.5 to 2.6 %, 8 to 13 times the 0.19 % cost of a round trip.
findings.F3: Falls are not mirrored: after daily falls of 1 to 2 and of more than 2 typical moves the next 5 days return +0.60 % (t 1.2, n 319) and +0.71 % (t 0.7, n 72), about the drift, so the continuation in F2 belongs to rises only; the quintiles of the day's return agree only at the top (top fifth +1.0 % over drift, t 2.1; slope t 1.74 across all five).
findings.F4: The Saturday daily bar rises more than the other days: mean +0.47 % (t 5.7, n 2 460), positive on all six coins (+0.17 % to +0.62 %) and in both halves of the record (+0.58 % to 2021, +0.36 % after), with Friday next (+0.31 %, t 3.3). It is a calendar effect with no grade in it, so I write no idea from it.
findings.F5: Measures of trend and of place in the recent range give no pattern on 1-day bars. These are the 20- and 60-day return, nearness to the 20-day high, breaking it, and distance above the 20- and 60-day low. Their pooled slopes on the 5-, 10- and 20-day forward move have t between -1.24 and +1.72, and their per-coin and per-half t's change sign. Neither volatility level nor the day's range sorts the next 5 days either (slope t 0.74 and 0.58).

ideas.idea: After a coin's daily rise, the larger that rise compared with its typical daily move over the past 20 days, the more the coin rises over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader leans long for about a week after an unusually strong up day, more so the stronger the day, and refuses shorts after one.
ideas.name: strong up-day keeps rising
